ti: the server recommends and scaffolds a pre-push hook running the local gates, so human pushes are gated like automated ones

note: [consent] recommendation-over-imposition is the right consent model - a hook write changes every future push and must be an explicit operator action (spectackle hook install), never a silent scaffold; NODE-EDGE fit: the opt-in is the judgment, the write is the edge. [unification] the hook shells to the binary so verify commands stay defined exactly once in config; no second gate vocabulary. [refute] tried: a hook referencing a dev-build path goes stale across rebuilds - shell to spectackle on PATH with the requirement stated in the hook comment; tried: the hint in check would break the CI byte-identity - state #health only, per the standing lesson. No kill.

The local gate now covers human pushes without imposition. spectackle verify runs the workspace verify commands (the ONE gate definition, shared with the done transition); spectackle hook install writes a pre-push hook shelling to it on PATH (inherits config and rebuilds, never a stale dev-build path), REFUSING to clobber a foreign hook with chaining guidance instead. The hint lives in state #health only (never check, per the CI byte-identity lesson): fires exactly when verify commands are configured and no hook runs them, clears on install, silent without verify commands or outside a git checkout - all four legs test-pinned, including a real end-to-end where the installed hook script fails on verify=[false] and passes on [true] with a purpose-built binary on PATH. The default path writes NOTHING into .git (asserted). Docs: lifecycle.md one-gate paragraph citing the consent model. LIVE: this repos state now renders the hint - installing is the operators opt-in by design, so it stays visible rather than being self-applied. One test-design lesson: gitRoot fixtures ship verify commands, so the silent-case test needed its own config - the hint firing there was the machinery being right about the fixture. Full suite green, gofmt/vet clean, lint 85 rules 0 findings, check ok. Not done: no config git.hooks auto-install knob (the explicit subcommand IS the consent; a config knob would let a committed file flip push behavior for every clone - exactly the slipped-in class ADR-01KYDG forbids).

[consent] the default writes nothing into .git (asserted), foreign hooks are refused with chaining guidance, and the opt-in is a deliberate subcommand - the rejected config-knob alternative is recorded with the committed-file-flips-push-behavior reasoning, which is the strongest part of the landing. [unification] the hook shells to spectackle verify on PATH: one gate definition, config-inherited, rebuild-proof. [refute] tried: PATH without spectackle makes the hook fail every push - acceptable and self-explaining (the hook comment names the requirement, and a failing hook is git-bypassable with --no-verify, the operators own escape). body: Foundation task of P-01KYJMVX2Q; the full design is the wf_0ed39152 synthesis (scratchpad bench-synthesis.md holds the authoritative copy - read sections 1-6 and 10 before writing code). BUILD internal/benchmark: record.go - Record{ID, Name, Key, Ver, Frame map[string]string, Metrics []Metric{Name,Unit,Dir,Noise}, Impls []Impl{Label,Src,Res map[string]float64}, T, Ag, Tool, Note, Dir}; key.go - CanonicalKey(name, frame): fold name and dim keys/values (lower, trim), sort dims k=v joined with | after validating REQUIRED os/arch/cpu/ram/gpu present (sentinels none and any are legal values per ADR-01KYJMWE1N), refuse forbidden separator characters in names/dims (=|;: and whitespace inside tokens), deterministic across insertion order; store.go - Load(path) parsing ndjson tolerantly (unknown fields preserved on rewrite via ordered generic decode like migrate does, or document lossy-struct round-trip as a decision), key recomputed and VERIFIED against the stored field at load (mismatch = corruption line, quarantine the line not the file), union-merge dedup (same ID wins once; same key+ver conflict resolves deterministic by T then ID), Put(rec) assigning Ver = head+1 on content change / idempotent unchanged detection byte-stable, TrimHistory(key, depth) keeping the newest depth versions; workspace wiring - BenchPath(ctx) beside SpecPath, bench.ndjson in the context-discovery allowlist and the gitattributes ensureLines (merge=union), config knob benchmarks: history: (default 1, load fallback) parallel to CompactCfg. NO tool surface in this task (task 2). TESTS: canonicalization matrix (order-independence, case folding, sentinel legality, forbidden chars refused, missing required dim refused), collision cases (two hosts differing only in ram = different keys; any collapses them), Put version monotonicity + idempotent replay + content-change detection, trim at depth 1 and depth 3, load-verify quarantine, union-merge dedup determinism. VERIFY: go build ./... && go test ./internal/benchmark/ ./internal/workspace/ -count=1 && gofmt -l . empty. SCOPE: the new package + workspace wiring only. ROLLBACK: revert.
